mapper.select: SELECT biz60_fund_price_modi_id AS fund_price_modi_id , biz60_report_type AS report_type , biz60_am_corp_nm AS am_corp_name , biz60_fund_nm AS fund_name , biz60_price_std_date AS price_std_date , biz60_modi_date AS modi_date , biz60_fund_close_yn AS fund_close_yn , biz60_bef_price AS bef_price , biz60_bef_full_price AS bef_full_price , biz60_bef_tax_price AS bef_tax_price , biz60_bef_full_tax_price AS bef_full_tax_price , biz60_aft_price AS aft_price , biz60_aft_full_price AS aft_full_price , biz60_aft_tax_price AS aft_tax_price , biz60_aft_full_tax_price AS aft_full_tax_price , biz60_bef_close_price AS bef_close_price , biz60_bef_close_full_price AS bef_close_full_price , biz60_bef_close_tax_price AS bef_close_tax_price , biz60_bef_close_full_tax_price AS bef_close_full_tax_price , biz60_aft_close_price AS aft_close_price , biz60_aft_close_full_price AS aft_close_full_price , biz60_aft_close_tax_price AS aft_close_tax_price , biz60_aft_close_full_tax_price AS aft_close_full_tax_price , biz60_first_person_nm AS first_person_name , biz60_disc_cause AS disc_cause , biz60_modi_reason AS modi_reason , biz60_prev_plan AS prev_plan , biz60_ksd_notice_yn AS ksd_notice_yn , biz60_kofia_notice_yn AS kofia_notice_yn , biz60_cmps_amt AS cmps_amt , ( SELECT STRING_AGG(sys10_file_nm, '<'||'br'||'>' ORDER BY sys10_file_id) FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = biz60_fund_price_modi_id ) AS file_list_html_str FROM biz60_fund_price_modi WHERE biz60_company_id = #{companyId} AND biz60_fund_price_modi_id = #{fundPriceModiId}
